messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "you may be able to dissolve the tablet in water"
set: ["you may be able to dissolve the tablet in water", "you may be able to mix the medicine from a capsule with soft food", "allow the orally disintegrating tablet to dissolve in your mouth without chewing", "dissolve omeprazole powder in a small amount of water", "dissolve under the tongue", "allow to dissolve in mouth without chewing", "swallow the regular tablet whole with a glass of water", "splitting the dose may be needed", "response to them may be reduced", "may be repeated at the same dose", "Patients may be switched to the extended-release 450 mg dose", "alcohol may cause the carvedilol in Coreg CR to be released too quickly into the body", "intravenous therapy should be discontinued as soon as the patient is able to resume oral therapy", "must chew the chewable tablet before you swallow it", "mix tablet with 1 or 2 teaspoons of water", "chew the chewable tablet well"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
